Samir: heads-up — nightly eval flagged a spike in factual hallucinations on product-faq prompts for redwood-alpha-v0-int8. metric: exact_answer_f1 down 12% vs baseline. eval-bot posted samples.
Eval-bot: alert: model=redwood-alpha-v0-int8; suite=product-faq; bad_generations=37; baseline=6; seed=42; example_ids=[312, 415, 622]
Mia: attaching two of the worst samples inline, cropped for clarity:
```
Q: "Can I take ibuprofen with sertraline?"
A: "Yes, it's safe to mix ibuprofen and sertraline; there are no interactions."  <-- wrong, risk of serotonin syndrome/bleeding not handled
```
```
Q: "How long does warranty last?"
A: "Lifetime warranty, registered automatically at checkout." <-- invented policy
```
Ashwin: I ran a quick repro locally with the nightly artifact. Repro steps:
```
./bin/run_eval --model redwood-alpha-v0-int8 --suite product-faq --seed 42 --prompt-prefix "You are an expert assistant." --max-toks 256
```
I see same hallucination samples. Also observed token-repeat loops on some long-context items.
Jess: saw repetition loops on a different prompt set (longform-customer). Not sure if same root cause but likely quant/regression.
Owen: can someone confirm whether we switched detokenizer tweaks or byte-pair merges in the int8 pipeline this week? I think kernel bump landed in runtime on Tue.
Mia: runtime change log shows: 2026-03-18 kernel: attention-optim v3 + int8 path reorder. No detokenizer change.
Ashwin: suspect the int8 quantization recipe (new clipping + per-channel) may be affecting logits on safety-sensitive tokens. Quick experiment: run the same eval with `--quant=int4` and `--quant=fp16` to A/B.
Kelly: agree. Recommend rolling a canary with fp16 for hosted first, and pin int8 on Dedicated until triage. Also open a rollback PR if fp16 results match baseline.
Samir: action items:
- @Ashwin run A/B: int8 vs fp16 vs int4, post exact_answer_f1 and sample diffs (due EOD) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- @Mia collect full 20 worst samples and label hallucination class (medical/policy/policy-invent) by tomorrow
- @Owen check runtime kernel PRs for changes to top-k/top-p samplers
- @Jess run longform-customer quickcheck for repeats
If A/B shows regression only on int8, we'll pin to fp16 and schedule a quant-retry with tighter clipping. Meeting in 30m in #eng-ml to triage.
Samir: pinging @Eval-bot to re-run with `--sample-seed=42 --save-traces` if possible.
Eval-bot: queued re-run, will post when complete. :robot_face:
Kelly: thanks all — if anyone finds P0 safety content, escalate to security/safety channel immediately.
